entities.name: Harald Fairhair & Unification of Norway
entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: Harald Fairhair's victory at the Battle of Hafrsfjord (c. 872) traditionally marking the unification of Norway into a single kingdom, the emigration of discontented chieftains to Iceland, and the establishment of royal authority.
